lines.zh: 小短腿迈得飞快，气在脚边跳。
lines.en: Short legs churn fast; ki hops at my feet.

lines.zh: 我漂浮着前进，比走路省事。
lines.en: I advance floating; easier than walking.
I am short, but my presence is not.

lines.zh: 我仰头看路，还得抬头看人。
lines.en: I look up at the road, and up at people.

lines.zh: 斗篷拖在地上，我懒得理。
lines.en: My cape drags; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 每走一步，土就被气掀开。
lines.en: Each step flips the soil with ki.
I round a fallen log without stopping.
My hair stands up; wind cannot move it.
My steps are small and quick.
I rub my nose with the back of my hand.
The roadside grass scorches in my aura.
I head toward the village.
Arms folded, I hover off the ground.
Small in size, not in presence.
I stare at the distant ridge.

lines.zh: 这点高度，我一步就能上去。
lines.en: One step would take me up there.
Ki circles me.
I tug my cape.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，脚离地半寸。
lines.en: I fold my arms, hovering half an inch up.
Who turned me into this?

lines.zh: 算了，身体小了也一样打。
lines.en: Never mind; small or not, I still fight.

lines.zh: 指节捏得响，我在等开打。
lines.en: My knuckles crack; I'm waiting for the fight.
Ki wraps my knuckles.
Stones lift under my feet.
I let them drop.
Wind passes over my head.

lines.zh: 我抬起头看你，脖子有点累。
lines.en: I look up at you; my neck tires of it.
You are nearly twice my height.
I purse my lips.

lines.zh: 看什么，没见过矮个赛亚人？
lines.en: What? Never seen a short Saiyan?
I raise a hand; ki lights in it.
This body is no hindrance.
Try me if you like.
I study your wrists.

lines.zh: 你的力气藏在哪儿，我看得出来。
lines.en: I can see where your strength sits.
I snort and turn my head.
I am not a child.
Though I look like one.

lines.zh: 我跳上石头，才和你平视。
lines.en: I hop onto a rock to meet your eyes.
This is much better.
Say what you will.
I glance at you once, then drop down.
Wind opens my cape.
I pin it shut.
I grunt.
One step back, then hold.
Blood at my mouth.

lines.zh: 变小了，气还是乱了一下。
lines.en: Small as I am, my ki still slipped.
I wipe it off.
This much.

lines.zh: 变小的王子，怒气没变小。
lines.en: A smaller prince, no smaller ego.
It hurts, but I can still stand.
I grit my teeth and stand straight.
Small as I am, I don't grunt when hit.
I shrunk; my temper did not.
Small does not mean easy to fool.
I can find my own.
I glance at it.
Saiyans do have big appetites.
But I have no time now.

lines.zh: 缩成这么小，气一点没少。
lines.en: Shrunk this small, and not a bit of ki less.
I fold my arms and turn away.
I step back and look up at you.
Small, but steady.
Your knee clips my shoulder.
I push you back a little.
I lift off to avoid your feet.
You step on my cape.
I pull it free.
We collide; the ground rings.
I do not fall.
I have no time.
This body makes it even less convenient.
I throw the thought away.
First I must return to my real form.
Ki turns in my chest.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的事，先打完再说。
lines.en: Saiyan business first; the rest after the fight.
There is real work.
Do not ask about such things.
I pick it up and look.
Too heavy, and taller than I am.
I drop it.
This I can carry.
I tuck it into my cape.
I squeeze it.
Boring.
I toss it aside.
Stowed.

lines.zh: 腿短，可气弹先到你面前。
lines.en: Short legs, but my ki blast arrives first.

lines.zh: 大魔里我变小了，脾气没小。
lines.en: Daima shrank me, not my temper.
You strike first.
That is where it breaks easiest.
Ki peels a layer off the ground.

lines.zh: 嘴角一挑，我的气就上来了。
lines.en: One corner of my mouth lifts, and my ki rises.
I had this planned long ago.

lines.zh: 我个子矮，气势一点不矮。
lines.en: I am short, but my pride is not.

lines.zh: 气在脚下一炸，人就没影了。
lines.en: My aura bursts at my feet and I'm gone.
Ki trails light behind my feet.
Do not underestimate me.

lines.zh: 上次的账，今天在地面算。
lines.en: We settle last time's score, here on the ground.
I rush in low.

lines.zh: 它抬脚，我从下面穿过去。
lines.en: It lifts a foot; I slip beneath it.
Ki blasts fire from my palm in a stream.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，它没察觉。
lines.en: I circle behind it unnoticed.
It cannot turn fast enough.
It retreats; I follow.

lines.zh: 个子小的好处是不好打。
lines.en: The advantage of being small is being hard to hit.
I leap over its arm.
Its guard has seams.
I gather ki in my palm.
The ground burns black in a ring.
Its breathing breaks.
The last shot.

lines.zh: 我抬手，迷你身体也照样放加利克炮。
lines.en: I raise my hand; this mini body still fires a Galick Gun.

lines.zh: 这副小身子，照样打得你飞。
lines.en: Small body, and I still knock you flying.
The wind tears.

lines.zh: 加利克炮已经顶在你胸口。
lines.en: Gallick Gun is already at your chest.
My kick lands on its knee.
Being low, I hit the waist.
Ki bursts on my knuckles.
I leap and strike its jaw.

lines.zh: 它低头，我从下面顶上去。
lines.en: It ducks; I drive up from below.
Three hits in a row.
It blocks; I circle to its flank.
I smash with my elbow.
I seize its fingers.
I wrench them open.
A kick knocks its shield wide.
A ki blast knocks it back.
I land, knees dipping.
I add the last punch.
My aura has not faded.

lines.zh: 我从光里落下来，个子很小。
lines.en: I drop out of the light, very small.
I land almost silently.
I do not like this body.
But the ki is still mine.
I straighten my cape.
Everything around is taller than I am.
Ki bends the grass down.
I test my fist.
The knuckles still obey.
I hop twice.
My speed remains.

lines.zh: 我从天边落下，尘土扑了一脸。
lines.en: I drop in from the horizon, dust in my face.
I head forward.
Soil curls around my feet.
I bare my teeth, white and small.
Let no one laugh.
Fire hits me; ki blocks half.
I hit the ground; the crater is bigger than me.
Water closes overhead; I kick.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
Magic binds me; I snap it.
Hunger thins my ki.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我头发更竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my hair stands even straighter.
The ground goes; I fall.
